    DataCleanR

    Tools for reproducible data cleaning and validation of tabular datasets.

    DataCleanR provides a comprehensive toolkit for cleaning and preprocessing tabular datasets, with a focus on salary and HR-style data. It helps you validate data schemas, standardise column names and text formats, handle missing values, and prepare clean datasets ready for analysis or reporting.

    Key features

    • Schema validation: check that incoming data matches the expected structure (columns, types, constraints).
    • Normalisation: standardise column names, text formats and categorical values for consistent downstream use.
    • Currency and amounts: clean and standardise monetary variables, including parsing, conversion and formatting.
    • Missing values handling: identify and treat missing or inconsistent values using simple rules or imputation strategies.
    • Data quality checks: compute basic quality indicators to quickly assess the reliability of your dataset.
    • Validation and export: apply validation rules, flag issues and export clean datasets in a reproducible way.

    Typical workflow

    A typical DataCleanR workflow consists of importing raw data, validating its structure, applying normalisation and cleaning steps, checking data quality and exporting a clean, well-documented dataset. The functions are designed to be combined into reproducible scripts or high-level pipelines so that the same cleaning logic can be reused on new data and across projects.

    Cleaning pipelines and modes

    DataCleanR supports different cleaning pipelines depending on your goal:

    • Classic cleaning: a balanced pipeline that fixes common issues (types, formats, missing values, basic quality checks) while keeping the data close to its original form, suitable for descriptive analysis and reporting.
    • ML-ready cleaning: a stricter pipeline that enforces tighter constraints on schema, missing values and outliers to produce datasets that are easier to use directly in modelling and machine learning workflows.
    • Custom pipelines: you can compose your own sequence of DataCleanR functions to create project-specific pipelines that reflect your business rules and quality requirements.
